## Overview

This post was my final project for EDS 242: Ethics and Bias in Environmental Data Science. We were asked to pick a real-world case of data bias and explore its causes, impacts, and solutions. I chose air quality monitoring because the data shapes public health decisions for millions of people, yet few of us ever ask where it comes from or who it leaves out.
